programs.source:
parse_dice =: 3 : 'num&> ''d'' split y'
resolve_attack =: 3 : 0
    'tohit defense count sides bonus' =. y
    value =. 1+rnd 20
    if. value=1 do. 0 0 return. end.
    if. value=20 do.
        first =. roll_dice count,sides
        second =. roll_dice count,sides
        2,1>.first+second+bonus
    elseif. (value+tohit)>:defense do.
        damage =. roll_dice count,sides
        1,1>.damage+bonus
    else. 0 0 end.
)
record_attack =: 4 : 0
    'outcome damage' =. y
    stats =. x
    stats =. (1+0{stats)0}stats
    if. outcome do.
        stats =. (1+1{stats)1}stats
        stats =. (damage+3{stats)3}stats
    end.
    stats =. ((2{stats)+outcome=2)2}stats
    stats
)

split_region =: 4 : 0
    'rx ry width height' =. 4{.y{Regions
    verticalfits =. width>:2*MinimumSize
    horizontalfits =. height>:2*MinimumSize
    if. (x=MaximumSplit)+.-.verticalfits+.horizontalfits do.
        Regions =: (#Leaves) (<y,6)}Regions
        Leaves =: Leaves,y
        i.0 return.
    end.
    if. verticalfits*.horizontalfits do.
        if. (4*width)>:5*height do. vertical =. 1
        elseif. (4*height)>:5*width do. vertical =. 0
        else. vertical =. 0=2|draw '' end.
    else. vertical =. verticalfits end.
    if. vertical do.
        cut =. MinimumSize+rnd 1+width-2*MinimumSize
        first =. rx,ry,cut,height
        second =. (rx+cut),ry,(width-cut),height
    else.
        cut =. MinimumSize+rnd 1+height-2*MinimumSize
        first =. rx,ry,width,cut
        second =. rx,(ry+cut),width,height-cut
    end.
    firstindex =. #Regions
    secondindex =. firstindex+1
    Regions =: Regions,first,_1 _1 _1
    Regions =: Regions,second,_1 _1 _1
    Regions =: firstindex (<y,4)}Regions
    Regions =: secondindex (<y,5)}Regions
    (x+1)split_region firstindex
    (x+1)split_region secondindex
    i.0
)
make_room =: 3 : 0
    'rx ry width height' =. 4{.y{Regions
    rw =. RoomMinimum+rnd 1+(RoomMaximum<.width-1)-RoomMinimum
    rh =. RoomMinimum+rnd 1+(RoomMaximum<.height-1)-RoomMinimum
    left =. rx+rnd width-rw
    top =. ry+rnd height-rh
    for_row. top+i.rh do.
        for_column. left+i.rw do.
            if. (row=top)+.row=top+rh-1 do. symbol =. '-'
            elseif. (column=left)+.column=left+rw-1 do. symbol =. '|'
            else. symbol =. '.' end.
            Terrain =: symbol (cell_index column,row)}Terrain
        end.
    end.
    left,top,rw,rh
)
room_center =: 3 : '(2{.y)+(2 3{y)div 2'
carve =: 3 : 0
    index =. cell_index y
    symbol =. index{Terrain
    if. symbol=' ' do. Terrain =: '#' index}Terrain
    elseif. symbol e.'-|' do. Terrain =: '+' index}Terrain end.
    i.0
)
inclusive_span =: 4 : 0
    if. y>:x do. x+i.1+y-x
    else. x-i.1+x-y end.
)
dig_corridor =: 3 : 0
    'ax ay bx by horizontal' =. y
    if. horizontal do.
        for_column. ax inclusive_span bx do. carve column,ay end.
        for_row. ay inclusive_span by do. carve bx,row end.
    else.
        for_row. ay inclusive_span by do. carve ax,row end.
        for_column. ax inclusive_span bx do. carve column,by end.
    end.
    i.0
)
connect_region =: 3 : 0
    region =. y{Regions
    if. (6{region)>:0 do. ,6{region return. end.
    first =. connect_region 4{region
    second =. connect_region 5{region
    besta =. bestb =. _1
    bestdistance =. 0
    for_a. first do.
        acenter =. room_center a{Rooms
        for_b. second do.
            bcenter =. room_center b{Rooms
            distance =. +/|acenter-bcenter
            if. (besta=_1)+.distance<bestdistance do.
                besta =. a
                bestb =. b
                bestdistance =. distance
            end.
        end.
    end.
    horizontal =. 0=2|draw ''
    dig_corridor (room_center besta{Rooms),(room_center bestb{Rooms),horizontal
    first,second
)
draw_interior_cell =: 3 : 0
    'left top width height' =. y{Rooms
    column =. left+1+rnd width-2
    row =. top+1+rnd height-2
    column,row
)
draw_room_cell =: 3 : 0
    room =. rnd #Rooms
    room,draw_interior_cell room
)
generate_terrain =: 3 : 0
    Terrain =: (MapWidth*MapHeight)$' '
    Memory =: Terrain
    Regions =: ,:0 0,MapWidth,MapHeight,_1 _1 _1
    Leaves =: 0$0
    0 split_region 0
    Rooms =: 0 4$0
    for_leaf. Leaves do. Rooms =: Rooms,make_room leaf end.
    connect_region 0
    'ArrivalRoom ax ay' =: draw_room_cell ''
    Arrival =: ax,ay
    Terrain =: '<' (cell_index Arrival)}Terrain
    other =. rnd (#Rooms)-1
    if. other>:ArrivalRoom do. other =. other+1 end.
    Target =: draw_interior_cell other
    i.0
)

read_monster_types =: 3 : 0
    MonsterNames =: MonsterTraits =: 0$a:
    MonsterSymbols =: ''
    MonsterValues =: 0 11$0
    for_line. read_lines 'monsters.txt' do.
        fields =. words >line
        MonsterNames =: MonsterNames,0{fields
        MonsterSymbols =: MonsterSymbols,1{::fields
        MonsterTraits =: MonsterTraits,11{fields
        values =. (num 2{::fields),(num 3{::fields),num 4{::fields
        values =. values,parse_dice 5{::fields
        values =. values,(num 6{::fields),(num 7{::fields),parse_dice 8{::fields
        values =. values,(num 9{::fields),num 10{::fields
        MonsterValues =: MonsterValues,values
    end.
    i.0
)
read_item_types =: 3 : 0
    ItemNames =: ItemCategories =: ItemEffects =: 0$a:
    ItemValues =: 0 9$0
    for_line. read_lines 'items.txt' do.
        fields =. words >line
        category =. 0{::fields
        effect =. ''
        values =. (num 2{::fields),(num 3{::fields),(num 4{::fields),1 1 0 0 0 0
        if. category-:'weapon' do.
            values =. (parse_dice 5{::fields)3 4}values
            values =. (num 6{::fields)5}values
        elseif. category-:'armor' do. values =. (num 5{::fields)6}values
        elseif. category-:'potion' do.
            effect =. 5{::fields
            if. effect-:'heal' do. values =. (parse_dice 6{::fields)3 4}values
            elseif. effect-:'poison' do. values =. (num 6{::fields)7}values end.
        elseif. category-:'scroll' do. effect =. 5{::fields
        elseif. category-:'food' do. values =. (num 5{::fields)8}values
        elseif. category-:'gold' do. values =. (parse_dice 5{::fields)3 4}values end.
        ItemNames =: ItemNames,1{fields
        ItemCategories =: ItemCategories,<category
        ItemEffects =: ItemEffects,<effect
        ItemValues =: ItemValues,values
    end.
    AmuletType =: #ItemNames
    ItemNames =: ItemNames,<'amulet'
    ItemCategories =: ItemCategories,<'amulet'
    ItemEffects =: ItemEffects,<''
    ItemValues =: ItemValues,0 0 0 1 1 0 0 0 0
    i.0
)
new_item =: 3 : 0
    identifier =. #ItemData
    ItemData =: ItemData,y
    identifier
)
item_category =: 3 : '((<y,0){ItemData){::ItemCategories'
item_symbol =: 3 : 0
    categories =. 'weapon';'armor';'potion';'scroll';'food';'gold';'amulet'
    (categories i.<item_category y){')[!?%$"'
)
item_name =: 3 : 0
    row =. y{ItemData
    name =. (0{row){::ItemNames
    name =. ' ' (I.name='_')}name
    category =. item_category y
    if. (<category)e.'weapon';'armor' do.
        '+',(number 4{row),' ',name
    elseif. category-:'gold' do. (number 3{row),' gold'
    else. name end.
)
item_reference =: 3 : 0
    if. 'gold'-:item_category y do. item_name y
    else. 'the ',item_name y end.
)
monster_at =: 3 : 0
    for_index. i.#Monsters do.
        row =. index{Monsters
        if. (8{row)*.y-:1 2{row do. index return. end.
    end.
    _1
)
item_at =: 3 : 0
    for_identifier. Floor do.
        if. y-:1 2{identifier{ItemData do. identifier return. end.
    end.
    _1
)
set_monster =: 4 : 'Monsters =: x (<y)}Monsters'
set_item =: 4 : 'ItemData =: x (<y)}ItemData'

DirectionNames =: 'N';'NE';'E';'SE';'S';'SW';'W';'NW'
Directions =: 8 2$0 _1 1 _1 1 0 1 1 0 1 _1 1 _1 0 _1 _1
cell_index =: 3 : '(0{y)+MapWidth*1{y'
passable =: 3 : 0
    'column row' =. y
    if. (column<0)+.(row<0)+.(column>:MapWidth)+.row>:MapHeight do. 0
    else. (cell_index y){Terrain e.'.#+<>' end.
)
can_move =: 4 : 0
    target =. x+y
    if. -.passable target do. 0 return. end.
    if. *./y~:0 do.
        ('+'~:(cell_index x){Terrain)*.'+'~:(cell_index target){Terrain
    else. 1 end.
)
ray_cells =: 4 : 0
    'column row' =. x
    'lastcolumn lastrow' =. y
    dx =. |lastcolumn-column
    dy =. |lastrow-row
    sx =. _1+2*lastcolumn>column
    sy =. _1+2*lastrow>row
    error =. dx-dy
    cells =. 0 2$0
    while. (column~:lastcolumn)+.row~:lastrow do.
        doubled =. 2*error
        if. doubled > -dy do. error =. error-dy
            column =. column+sx end.
        if. doubled<dx do. error =. error+dx
            row =. row+sy end.
        cells =. cells,column,row
    end.
    cells
)
field_of_view =: 3 : 0
    visible =. (MapWidth*MapHeight)$0
    'px py' =. Position
    lowrow =. 0>.py-Radius
    highrow =. MapHeight<.py+Radius+1
    lowcolumn =. 0>.px-Radius
    highcolumn =. MapWidth<.px+Radius+1
    for_row. lowrow+i.highrow-lowrow do.
        for_column. lowcolumn+i.highcolumn-lowcolumn do.
            if. (((column-px)^2)+(row-py)^2)>Radius^2 do. continue. end.
            ray =. Position ray_cells column,row
            clear =. 1
            for_point. }:ray do.
                if. -.passable point do. clear =. 0 break. end.
            end.
            visible =. clear (cell_index column,row)}visible
        end.
    end.
    visible
)
distance_map =: 3 : 0
    distance =. (MapWidth*MapHeight)$_1
    distance =. 0 (cell_index Position)}distance
    queue =. ,:Position
    head =. 0
    while. head<#queue do.
        point =. head{queue
        head =. head+1
        for_direction. Directions do.
            if. point can_move direction do.
                target =. point+direction
                index =. cell_index target
                if. _1=index{distance do.
                    distance =. (1+(cell_index point){distance)index}distance
                    queue =. queue,target
                end.
            end.
        end.
    end.
    distance
)

ScriptPath =: >{:4!:3''
SourceDirectory =: (1+>./_1,I.ScriptPath e.'/\'){.ScriptPath
Digits =: '0123456789'
div =: 4 : '_1 x:<.(x:x)%x:y'
num =: 3 : '10#.Digits i.y'
number =: 3 : 0
    prefix =. ''
    if. y<0 do. prefix =. '-'
        y =. -y end.
    text =. ''
    while. y>0 do.
        text =. ((10|y){Digits),text
        y =. y div 10
    end.
    if. #text do. prefix,text else. '0' end.
)
split =: 4 : 0
    parts =. 0$a:
    while. 1 do.
        position =. y i.x
        parts =. parts,<position{.y
        if. position=#y do. parts return. end.
        y =. (position+1)}.y
    end.
)
words =: 3 : 0
    parts =. ' ' split y
    parts#~0<#&>parts
)
join =: 4 : 0
    text =. ''
    for_index. i.#y do.
        if. index do. text =. text,x end.
        text =. text,index{::y
    end.
    text
)
format =: 4 : 0
    parts =. '|' split x
    text =. 0{::parts
    for_index. i.#y do.
        value =. index{::y
        if. 2~:3!:0 value do. value =. number value end.
        text =. text,value,(index+1){::parts
    end.
    text
)
decimal_one =: 3 : 0
    'numerator denominator' =. y
    if. denominator=0 do. '-' return. end.
    rounded =. ((20*numerator)+denominator)div 2*denominator
    (number rounded div 10),'.',(10|rounded){Digits
)
read_lines =: 3 : '<;._2 (1!:1 <''input/'',y)'
load SourceDirectory,'minstd.ijs'
load SourceDirectory,'combat.ijs'
load SourceDirectory,'entities.ijs'
load SourceDirectory,'fov.ijs'
load SourceDirectory,'dungeon_gen.ijs'
read_config =: 3 : 0
    ConfigKeys =: ConfigValues =: 0$a:
    for_line. read_lines 'config.txt' do.
        fields =. words >line
        ConfigKeys =: ConfigKeys,{.fields
        ConfigValues =: ConfigValues,<}.fields
    end.
    'GenerationState GameState' =: num&> config 'seed'
    'MapWidth MapHeight' =: num&> config 'map'
    'MinimumSize MaximumSplit' =: num&> config 'bsp'
    'RoomMinimum RoomMaximum' =: num&> config 'room'
    LevelCount =: num 0{::config 'levels'
    'MonsterBase MonsterStep' =: num&> config 'monsters'
    'ItemBase ItemStep' =: num&> config 'items'
    'SleepChance WakeChance' =: num&> config 'sleep'
    Radius =: num 0{::config 'fov'
    'InitialHp Regeneration' =: num&> config 'player'
    HitDie =: parse_dice 0{::config 'hitdie'
    'InitialFood MaximumFood HungryThreshold WeakThreshold' =: num&> config 'food'
    PackLimit =: num 0{::config 'pack'
    StartNames =: config 'start'
    XpThresholds =: num&> config 'xp'
    Checkpoints =: num&> config 'checkpoints'
    i.0
)
config =: 3 : '(ConfigKeys i.<y){::ConfigValues'
read_commands =: 3 : 0
    Commands =: 0$a:
    for_line. read_lines 'commands.txt' do.
        fields =. words >line
        name =. 0{::fields
        argument =. ''
        count =. 1
        if. name-:'wait' do.
            if. (#fields)=2 do. count =. num 1{::fields end.
        else.
            if. (#fields)>1 do. argument =. 1{::fields end.
            if. (#fields)=3 do. count =. num 2{::fields end.
        end.
        for_repeat. i.count do. Commands =: Commands,<(<name),<argument end.
    end.
    i.0
)
save_level =: 3 : 0
    index =. Depth-1
    TerrainLevels =: (<Terrain)index}TerrainLevels
    MemoryLevels =: (<Memory)index}MemoryLevels
    RoomLevels =: (<Rooms)index}RoomLevels
    MonsterLevels =: (<Monsters)index}MonsterLevels
    FloorLevels =: (<Floor)index}FloorLevels
    i.0
)
load_level =: 3 : 0
    index =. Depth-1
    Terrain =: index{::TerrainLevels
    Memory =: index{::MemoryLevels
    Rooms =: index{::RoomLevels
    Monsters =: index{::MonsterLevels
    Floor =: index{::FloorLevels
    i.0
)
build_levels =: 3 : 0
    TerrainLevels =: MemoryLevels =: RoomLevels =: MonsterLevels =: FloorLevels =: ArrivalLevels =: LevelCount$a:
    Created =: Placed =: LevelKills =: LevelPicked =: LevelCount$0
    ItemData =: 0 5$0
    RngMode =: 0
    for_depth. 1+i.LevelCount do.
        Depth =: depth
        generate_terrain ''
        Floor =: 0$0
        Monsters =: 0 9$0
        if. depth<LevelCount do. Terrain =: '>' (cell_index Target)}Terrain
        else. Floor =: Floor,new_item AmuletType,Target,0 0 end.
        candidates =. I.((0{"1 MonsterValues)<:depth)*.(1{"1 MonsterValues)>:depth
        weights =. 2{"1 candidates{MonsterValues
        count =. MonsterBase+MonsterStep*depth-1
        for_number. i.count do.
            kind =. (weighted_select weights){candidates
            while. 1 do.
                'room column row' =. draw_room_cell ''
                point =. column,row
                if. (room~:ArrivalRoom)*.('.'=(cell_index point){Terrain)*._1=monster_at point do. break. end.
            end.
            hp =. roll_dice 3 4{kind{MonsterValues
            asleep =. (100|draw '')<SleepChance
            Monsters =: Monsters,kind,column,row,hp,hp,asleep,0 0 1
        end.
        Created =: count (depth-1)}Created
        candidates =. I.((0{"1 ItemValues)<:depth)*.(1{"1 ItemValues)>:depth
        weights =. 2{"1 candidates{ItemValues
        count =. ItemBase+ItemStep*depth-1
        for_number. i.count do.
            kind =. (weighted_select weights){candidates
            while. 1 do.
                'room column row' =. draw_room_cell ''
                point =. column,row
                if. ('.'=(cell_index point){Terrain)*._1=item_at point do. break. end.
            end.
            amount =. 0
            if. 'gold'-:kind{::ItemCategories do. amount =. roll_dice 3 4{kind{ItemValues end.
            Floor =: Floor,new_item kind,column,row,amount,0
        end.
        Placed =: (#Floor)(depth-1)}Placed
        ArrivalLevels =: (<Arrival)(depth-1)}ArrivalLevels
        save_level ''
    end.
    RngMode =: 1
    i.0
)
initialize_player =: 3 : 0
    Depth =: 1
    load_level ''
    Position =: 0{::ArrivalLevels
    Hp =: MaximumHp =: InitialHp
    Food =: InitialFood
    PlayerLevel =: 1
    Xp =: Gold =: Poison =: 0
    Pack =: 0$0
    Weapon =: Armor =: _1
    for_name. StartNames do.
        kind =. ItemNames i.name
        identifier =. new_item kind,Position,0 0
        Pack =: Pack,identifier
        if. ('weapon'-:kind{::ItemCategories)*.Weapon=_1 do. Weapon =: identifier end.
        if. ('armor'-:kind{::ItemCategories)*.Armor=_1 do. Armor =: identifier end.
    end.
    Turn =: 1
    Succeeded =: Failed =: Unused =: Moves =: PoisonDamage =: StarvationDamage =: 0
    Usage =: 6$0
    Kills =: (#MonsterNames)$0
    PlayerAttacks =: MonsterAttacks =: 4$0
    Messages =: Maps =: 0$a:
    Result =: Cause =: ''
    i.0
)
say =: 3 : 0
    stamp =. number Turn
    Messages =: Messages,<((0>.4-#stamp)$'0'),stamp,' ',y
    i.0
)
hunger =: 3 : 0
    if. Food>HungryThreshold do. 'normal'
    elseif. Food>WeakThreshold do. 'hungry'
    elseif. Food>0 do. 'weak'
    else. 'starving' end.
)
player_defense =: 3 : 0
    if. Armor=_1 do. 10
    else. row =. Armor{ItemData
        10+(6{(0{row){ItemValues)+4{row end.
)
die =: 3 : 0
    say 'You die.'
    Result =: 'died'
    Cause =: y
    i.0
)
update_view =: 3 : 0
    Visible =: field_of_view ''
    for_index. I.Visible do.
        point =. (MapWidth|index),index div MapWidth
        identifier =. item_at point
        symbol =. index{Terrain
        if. identifier>:0 do. symbol =. item_symbol identifier end.
        Memory =: symbol index}Memory
    end.
    for_index. i.#Monsters do.
        row =. index{Monsters
        if. -.8{row do. continue. end.
        seen =. (cell_index 1 2{row){Visible
        if. seen*.-.7{row do. say 'You see the ',((0{row){::MonsterNames),'.' end.
        seen set_monster index,7
    end.
    i.0
)
gain_xp =: 3 : 0
    Xp =: Xp+y
    while. PlayerLevel<:#XpThresholds do.
        if. Xp<(PlayerLevel-1){XpThresholds do. break. end.
        PlayerLevel =: PlayerLevel+1
        increase =. roll_dice HitDie
        MaximumHp =: MaximumHp+increase
        Hp =: Hp+increase
        say 'Welcome to level ',(number PlayerLevel),'.'
    end.
    i.0
)
player_attack =: 3 : 0
    0 set_monster y,5
    row =. y{Monsters
    kind =. 0{row
    values =. kind{MonsterValues
    name =. kind{::MonsterNames
    tohit =. PlayerLevel
    bonus =. 0
    dice =. 1 2
    if. Weapon>:0 do.
        weapon =. Weapon{ItemData
        weaponvalues =. (0{weapon){ItemValues
        bonus =. 4{weapon
        tohit =. tohit+bonus+5{weaponvalues
        dice =. 3 4{weaponvalues
    end.
    if. (<hunger '')e.'weak';'starving' do. tohit =. tohit-2 end.
    attack =. resolve_attack tohit,(6{values),dice,bonus
    PlayerAttacks =: PlayerAttacks record_attack attack
    'outcome damage' =. attack
    if. outcome=0 do. say 'You miss the ',name,'.' return. end.
    adjective =. ' for '
    if. outcome=2 do. adjective =. ' hard for ' end.
    say 'You hit the ',name,adjective,(number damage),'.'
    remaining =. (3{row)-damage
    remaining set_monster y,3
    if. remaining<:0 do.
        say 'You kill the ',name,'.'
        0 set_monster y,8
        LevelKills =: (1+(Depth-1){LevelKills)(Depth-1)}LevelKills
        Kills =: (1+kind{Kills)kind}Kills
        gain_xp 10{values
    end.
    i.0
)
monster_attack =: 3 : 0
    kind =. (<y,0){Monsters
    values =. kind{MonsterValues
    name =. kind{::MonsterNames
    attack =. resolve_attack (5{values),(player_defense ''),(7 8{values),0
    MonsterAttacks =: MonsterAttacks record_attack attack
    'outcome damage' =. attack
    if. outcome=0 do. say 'The ',name,' misses you.' return. end.
    adjective =. ' hits you for '
    if. outcome=2 do. adjective =. ' hits you hard for ' end.
    say 'The ',name,adjective,(number damage),'.'
    Hp =: Hp-damage
    if. Hp<:0 do. die 'killed_by ',name
    elseif. 'P'e.kind{::MonsterTraits do.
        Poison =: Poison+5
        say 'You are poisoned.'
    end.
    i.0
)
move_player =: 3 : 0
    target =. Position+y
    if. -.passable target do.
        say 'You bump into a wall.'
        0 return.
    end.
    if. -.Position can_move y do.
        say 'You cannot move diagonally through a door.'
        0 return.
    end.
    monster =. monster_at target
    if. monster>:0 do. player_attack monster
        1 return. end.
    Position =: target
    Moves =: Moves+1
    identifier =. item_at Position
    if. identifier>:0 do. say 'You see ',(item_reference identifier),' here.'
    elseif. '>'=(cell_index Position){Terrain do. say 'There is a staircase down here.' end.
    1
)
pickup =: 3 : 0
    identifier =. item_at Position
    if. identifier=_1 do.
        say 'There is nothing here.'
        0 return.
    end.
    category =. item_category identifier
    if. category-:'gold' do.
        Gold =: Gold+(<identifier,3){ItemData
        say 'You pick up ',(item_name identifier),'.'
    elseif. category-:'amulet' do.
        say 'You pick up the amulet.'
        say 'You win!'
        Result =: 'won'
        Cause =: 'amulet'
    elseif. (#Pack)>:PackLimit do.
        say 'Your pack is full.'
        0 return.
    else.
        Pack =: Pack,identifier
        say 'You pick up the ',(item_name identifier),' (',(number #Pack),').'
